description: The full record of one event occurrence from search_events, in a hub of mygn.de (Hamburg, München, Oldenburg + Umland) and rundown.city (San Francisco): summary, start and end time, venue with address and coordinates, price text, age_min, the audience block (family, adults_only, visitor_pick, family_p as in search_events; null when not rated), the organiser's link (url), the link to this event's own page on our site or, without one, our hub page (share_url), brand (mygn or rundown) and attribution_url (the hub page to cite as the source), plus the next 20 other dates of the same event (siblings, with siblings_truncated true when there are more). Internal fields (signals, series_kind, kind, title_override) are left out unless verbose is true. all_day true means the occurrence spans the whole day (T00:00 start, ends_at at least 18 hours later). time_unknown true means starts_at is only a date anchor, not a start time: never show 00:00. series_continues true means the listed dates of this recurring event stop only where our sources' look-ahead stops, so it likely runs on: never say it ends after the last listed date. Use url for the organiser's page, where tickets and opening details are.

Audience.description:
The pre-computed audience verdict of one event (docs/specs/mcp-public.md).

``family`` and ``adults_only`` are the routed booleans (null when neither
the model nor a rule decides); ``family_p`` is the raw family-friendly
probability so a caller can set its own threshold; ``visitor_pick`` is a
0..1 ranking hint, not a filter.
